notes.content:
[list]
[*] Patched a big bug that was causing the game to freeze when playing on slower speeds
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] LIGHTNING now chains its damage one enemy at a time instead of all at once (still plays the same just displays differently and cuts down on race conditions)
[*] Camera sticker is now working properly
[*] Paperclip now sets the rank of its card instead of adding to it
[*] You now actually can't set enemies ALIGHT when Bladder is in play
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get the same boss for two stages in a row
[*] Swamp now applies whenever an EARTH card's target is made wet
[*] Fixed a bug where you could make an infinite loop with 2 Lord of Lightning Stickers
[*] Stock Market now sells after applying
[*] Fixed a display bug where multiple values lower than 1 (i.e. with Eye) were showing as 1
[*] The background now goes grey when in discard mode
[*] Burning and Steam damage should now show properly in the final damage count 
[*] Fixed a bug where the final damage count was taking predicted damage into account
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would go to negative health but not be destroyed (had to do with LIGHTNING chain bug)
[*] The discard mode button now updates when the discards themselves change
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't drag the sticker in the shop tutorial
[*] When the deck has 6 or fewer cards, you now can't click on the draw and discard piles (before you could click on them even though they were invisible)
[*] Damage predictions in the enemy tooltips are now shown immediately (instead of needing to move your mouse off and back on)
[*] Damage predictions in enemy tooltips now show next to the mouse, meaning the enemy tooltip should never be cut off by the screen
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where shop didn't reroll
[*]Added background brightness option to the menu
[*]Fixed a few typos
[*]Added a tutorial for when you run out of plays but still have discards you don't automatically lose
[/list]

notes.title: v0.2.4.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes + New Stickers Added:
[list]
[*] Buried Treasure – +5 coins when targeting a wet card
[*] Cricket Bat – RANK 4 and 6 cards deal double damage if this sticker is in your played hand
[*] Fire Lightning – Chained lightning damage now acts like fire
[*] Ice Cream – +20 to card number; destroy this sticker if targeting an ALIGHT card
[*] Iron (Club) – Add 1 to this card’s number between 1 and 10 times
[*] Iron (Shirts) – Every time this card’s number is increased, multiply STEAM by 2
[*] Basketball – +1 additional card number every time this card’s number is increased
[*] Lightning Rod – Retriggers all stickers (excluding SWORD) on this card for every card hit with LIGHTNING chain damage
[*] Rugby Ball – Triggers the stickers on the next lowest-ranked card in your played hand
[*] Soul Fire – Double BURNING; ALIGHT cards will not spread fire this turn
[*] Stock Market – Double coins if the targeted enemy is destroyed before this sticker triggers
[*] Swamp – EARTH cards deal double damage to WET cards for every Swamp in your dealt hand
[*] Garbage Bin – +1 discard
[*] Cleaning Spray – Divide the targeted card’s health by 2 instead of dealing damage; makes the card dry
[*] Watch – +1 RAMP every time played (resets after 12)
[*] Static Electricity – When discarded, adds its card number to every LIGHTNING card played for the rest of the room
[*] Hoarder – +RAMP equal to the number of cards in your dealt hand
[*] Knives Out – +5 to card number for each SWORD sticker in your dealt hand
[*] Database – RAMP will not reset at the end of the turn
[*] Sun – x2 BURNING for every card set ON FIRE while this card is in hand
[*] Target Practice – After this card plays, it will target the enemy to the left and play again
[/list]

notes.title: v0.2.4.0
notes.content:

notes.title: v0.2.3.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] UI tweaks
[*] You can now right click empty space to deselect all cards
[*] Saving system updated, you can now save in any room and be reloaded back there
[*] Added new stickers:
Trees	 +2 RAMP for every EARTH card in PLAYED HAND
Flush	 +10 RAMP If all cards in PLAYED HAND are the same suit
Board Game	CARD NUMBERs will not reset for the rest of the room
Schooner	 x4.25 CARD NUMBER, -1 RAMP for every Schooner sticker in hand, 
Sauna	x2 STEAM for every BURNING card
Spark	When discarded, set a random card ALIGHT
Water Bottle	Add the rank of all WATER cards in played hand to ramp
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.3 Change Log
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Combined all the suit ramps into 1 singular ramp, redesigned the ramp machine so higher numbers don't get cut off
[*] Introduced scientific notation for bigger numbers
[*] Changed Run It Back Card's functionality so now it copies the abilities of the card to the right instead of replaying
[*] Changed the functionality of Flame/steam Surge so now the counter triggers when the card itself is played, rather than at the start of the round. This also fixed the bug where the counter wouldn't reset
[*] Made the Burner and Steamer cards rarer
[*] Fixed bug where the game wasn't progressing if loaded in from a save, or if the cards died to fire
[*] Actually fixed bug where you could sell cards from your hand in the shop
[*] Fixed bug where cards were coming up face down in the discard pile
[*] You no longer have to enter a save name to create a save, if you just create it a name will be generated
[*] The discard mode button is now disabled if you're out of discards
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.2 Change Log
notes.content:

[*] Fixed bug where the sell buttons on hand cards would still be visible after leaving the shop
[*] Fixed bug where you could save and reload to change the suit eye cards are resistant to
[*] Updated the main menu layout
[/list]
